name: Exited or parked records free their project and machine seats; the base retained them
A surviving process in a nested or symlinked worktree holds a seat until it exits
Missing or unreadable worktrees and uncertain endpoint liveness retain seats
Unavailable process scanning fails closed and restored scanning frees the seat
Completed-release sentinel records still hold no seat when agents are gone
Registered local homes and same-origin clones share the live seat rule
A real live Codex agent retains its seat even with an idle worktree or released-copy sentinel
A retained exited record permits a real worker launch; the live worker blocks the next launch at the project cap
